title: Vanakkam Da Mappilei
desc: Two childhood friends make a pact to get married at the same time. However, while one easily finds a match, the other struggles to find a bride.

title: Kuthu
desc: Anjali, the daughter of a powerful gangster, is in love with Gurumoorthy, a young man. However, Veerabahu, Anjali's father, disapproves of their union and tries to separate them.

title: Kaththi Sandai
desc: A small-time farmer, decides to steal and loots money from corrupt government officials in order to develop his remote village.

title: Thiruda Thirudi
desc: Vasu, a youngster, is considered irresponsible by the woman he loves and his family. In order to gain their approval, he decides to mend his ways and prove his worth.

title: Soorarai Pottru
desc: A young man from a remote village dreams of launching his own airline service and must overcome various challenges in his quest.
